questions.question: True or False: Blackburn Rovers are the only former Premier League champions to have suffered relegation to League One (the third tier of English football).
questions.anchorClues: 1994–95 Premier League champions Blackburn Rovers were relegated from the Championship to League One at the end of the 2016–17 season.

questions.question: Which club scored the fewest total goals in a single Premier League season, netting just 20 goals across 38 matches in 2007–08?
questions.anchorClues: Derby County scored only 20 goals during their 2007–08 campaign while managing just a single victory all season.

questions.question: Which player registered 20 direct assists during the 2002–03 season, establishing the original single-season Premier League record?
questions.anchorClues: Thierry Henry set the benchmark with 20 assists for Arsenal in 2002–03, a total later matched by Kevin De Bruyne in 2019–20.

questions.question: Who scored Portsmouth's winning goal in the 2008 FA Cup Final during their famous mid-2000s Premier League era?
questions.anchorClues: Nwankwo Kanu scored the only goal in Portsmouth's 1–0 win over Cardiff City at Wembley Stadium on 17 May 2008.

questions.question: Which player scored four goals in a single match for Arsenal during their 4–4 draw against Liverpool at Anfield in April 2009?
questions.anchorClues: Russian playmaker Andrey Arshavin famously scored all four of Arsenal's goals in a thrilling 4–4 draw at Anfield on 21 April 2009.

questions.question: Which manager led West Ham United to a 5th-place Premier League finish in the 1998–99 season, their highest-ever top-flight finish in the Premier League era?
questions.anchorClues: Harry Redknapp guided West Ham United to 5th place in 1998–99, accumulating 57 points with a squad featuring Paolo Di Canio and Frank Lampard.

questions.question: Which French defender made 274 Premier League appearances for Arsenal between 1998 and 2006, winning two Premier League titles and three FA Cups?
questions.anchorClues: Cameroon international Lauren (born in Cameroon to Equatorial Guinean parents) held down the right-back slot for Arsenal's 'Invincibles' side.

questions.question: Who holds the record for scoring the most direct free-kick goals in Premier League history, with 18 free-kicks converted?
questions.anchorClues: David Beckham scored 18 direct free-kick goals for Manchester United between 1996 and 2003.

questions.question: Which player holds the Premier League record for most goal contributions (goals + assists) in a single 38-match season, involvement in 44 total goals in 2002–03?
questions.anchorClues: Thierry Henry scored 24 goals and registered 20 assists in 2002–03 to set the all-time 38-match goal contribution mark of 44.

questions.question: Which manager achieved the highest-ever points total for a newly promoted club in a 38-match Premier League season, accumulating 66 points with Newcastle United in 1993–94?
questions.anchorClues: Kevin Keegan led newly promoted Newcastle United to a 3rd-place finish on 77 points in a 42-game season (equivalent to 66 points across 38 games).
